The menu

Desserts, one scene at a time

Warm chocolate desserts, cakes and waffles, served through the day. Call 050 16390 43 or message on Instagram to order.

Warm chocolate, at the heart of it

Warm chocolate runs through the MO&ME menu, from the lava cakes to the hot chocolate. Ask the team what is warm and ready when you visit. MO&ME is open every day until 12:00 AM, so there is always time for a sweet stop after dinner in Jumeirah 1.

Dessert should feel personal, hosted, and memorable.

That belief is where MO&ME started. The shop opened on 7 November 2026 at Wasl Vita Mall on Wasl Road, in the heart of Jumeirah 1.

It is a place built around being looked after. Warm chocolate, cakes from the counter, coffee and matcha, and a team that hosts you, not just serves you. Come for a quiet coffee, a dessert with friends, or a late sweet stop. We are open until midnight every day.

Plan your visit

Drinks, poured all day

Coffee, matcha and more, poured through the day. Ask in store for the full drinks list.

Modern Matcha Creations

Matcha made the modern way, smooth, green and refreshing.

Rich Hot Chocolate

Deep, rich and warming, the comforting cup on the menu.

Signature Mocktails

House mocktails, mixed fresh and made to look as good as they taste.

Coffee

Brewed and poured through the day, for a quiet break or a dessert on the side.

Refreshing Blends

Cold and light blends for something refreshing, alongside the warm chocolate desserts.

Then the lava pours.

Warm chocolate is the heart of MO&ME, and the lava cake is where it shows. The cake arrives warm, the centre soft, and the chocolate does the rest.

Keep going and watch it happen, the way it does at the table, one pour at a time.
